title: Singapore Stocks’ Record Run Gets ‘Goldilocks’ Boost From Growth
summary: Singapore’s stocks have outperformed the world over the past month as their traditional strengths of high dividend yields and resilient balance sheets get a lift from a “Goldilocks” economic backdrop.
